all_IK.scope: Current-swing leg snapshots per replan, not unique physical swings or failures. All minima/maxima and never-above counts below refer to saved control knots, not continuous polynomial extrema.
all_IK.extrema_scope: saved_control_knots_only; no continuous derivative-root extrema were computed in this W51 review

old_trajectory_phase_opportunity.meaning: Array-only description of the old W51 trajectory, not a prediction of a repaired controller or an additional admission gate.
old_trajectory_phase_opportunity.caution: Do not gate on exact sign of measured foot vz: roundoff-sized negative velocities are present.

recorded_install_identities.scope: Existing recorder content identities; no new whole-repository hashing.
